title.en: Common Nails Buying Guide: Sizes, Finishes, Packing and China Supply
title.zh: 普通圆钉采购指南：尺寸、表面处理、包装与中国供应

description.en: Compare common nail sizes, timber penetration rules, finishes, packing and tests, then plan dependable China supply to Beira, Durban and Southern Africa.
description.zh: 从尺寸、木材厚度、表面处理到包装与验货，掌握普通圆钉采购要点，并规划中国至贝拉和德班的南部非洲供应，适用于津巴布韦、赞比亚、南非和莫桑比克的项目采购。

keywords: common nails, common nail sizes, 4 inch common nails, galvanized common nails, common nails 25kg carton, common nails vs box nails

heading.en: What Common Nails Are: Flat Head Wire Nails
heading.zh: 什么是普通圆钉：平头线材钉

body.en: Common nails are general-purpose wire nails made by cutting and forming steel wire, then producing a round shank, flat circular head and pointed diamond or chisel tip. The flat head gives a hammer a broad striking surface and helps spread pressure over the timber surface. The shank is usually smooth, so the nail is easy to drive but has less withdrawal resistance than a ring-shank or screw-shank nail. Common nails are often specified for framing, pallets, crates, fencing repairs, roof timber, general carpentry and temporary construction work. They are not the same as box nails: box nails normally have a thinner shank and smaller head for lighter boards, while common nails are heavier and better suited to structural timber connections where the design permits. When buying, state the diameter or wire gauge, length, finish, material, head style, point, packing weight and applicable target standard. ASTM F1667 can be used as a reference for driven fasteners, but the purchaser should confirm the required product class and test method. A practical purchasing description is 4 inch, smooth shank, flat head, bright steel common nail, packed in 25 kg cartons. Ask for a dimensional sample or drawing before mass production, especially when a machine or pneumatic nailer requires a defined collation format.
body.zh: 普通圆钉是通用型线材钉，通常由钢丝经过切断、成形和打尖制成，具有圆形钉杆、平圆头以及菱形或凿形尖端。平头为锤子提供较大的敲击面，也能把压力分散到木材表面。钉杆一般为光杆，便于打入，但抗拔力低于环纹钉或螺纹钉。普通圆钉常用于木框架、托盘、木箱、围栏维修、屋面木材、一般木工和临时施工。在允许的结构连接中，它比箱钉更重、更适合较厚木材；箱钉通常钉杆更细、钉头更小，适用于轻型板材。采购时应明确直径或线规、长度、表面处理、材质、钉头、钉尖、包装重量及适用目标标准。ASTM F1667可作为驱动紧固件的参考，但买方仍应确认具体产品类别和试验方法。实用的采购描述可以是：4英寸、光杆、平头、亮面钢制普通圆钉，25公斤纸箱包装。如设备或气动打钉机需要特定排钉形式，应在批量生产前要求尺寸样品或图纸确认。

heading.en: Common Nail Size Chart: 1 Inch to 8 Inch
heading.zh: 普通圆钉尺寸表：1英寸至8英寸

body.en: Length is normally the first ordering dimension, but length alone does not define a common nail. A buyer should also specify shank diameter, head diameter and tolerance. The following range is a practical industry guide; exact diameters vary by manufacturer, wire gauge system and target standard. 1 inch nails are commonly used for thin trim, small crates and light repairs, often with a relatively fine shank. 1.5 to 2 inch nails suit battens, thin boards, panel fixing and general joinery. 2.5 to 3 inch nails are common choices for framing members, pallet assembly and medium timber. 3.5 to 4 inch nails are used for heavier framing, roof structures and thicker softwood. 5 to 6 inch nails are selected for large timber, landscaping timbers, poles or deep connections, subject to engineering requirements. 7 to 8 inch nails are specialty sizes for very thick wood and should be checked carefully for straightness, point quality and driving equipment. For a quote, write dimensions in both units, such as 4 inch x 4.0 mm x 100 mm, if your market uses mixed inch and metric terminology. Confirm whether the stated length is measured from the underside of the head to the point, and whether the diameter is measured on the shank rather than the head. Request a size chart, sample count and carton label before approval.
body.zh: 长度通常是采购普通圆钉时的第一项尺寸，但仅说明长度并不足够。买方还应明确钉杆直径、钉头直径和允许公差。下面的范围属于实用的行业参考，实际直径会因制造商、线规体系和目标标准而不同。1英寸钉常用于薄装饰条、小木箱和轻型维修，钉杆通常较细。1.5至2英寸适合木条、薄板、板材固定和一般木工连接。2.5至3英寸常用于木框架、托盘组装和中等厚度木材。3.5至4英寸适合较重的框架、屋面结构和较厚软木。5至6英寸可用于大截面木材、景观木、木柱或深连接，但应服从工程要求。7至8英寸属于厚木材专用尺寸，应重点检查直线度、钉尖质量和打钉设备适配性。询价时建议同时使用英制和公制，例如4英寸×4.0毫米×100毫米，避免市场术语混用造成误解。应确认长度是否从钉头下方量至钉尖，直径是否测量钉杆而不是钉头。批准前应索取尺寸表、样品数量和纸箱标签。

heading.zh: 根据木材厚度选择钉长

body.en: Select nail length by calculating the material stack-up, required penetration and the risk of breakthrough. A useful starting rule for ordinary timber is to choose a nail that penetrates at least 2 to 2.5 times the thickness of the thinner piece being fixed, while still leaving enough embedment in the supporting member. This is a typical practical guideline, not a substitute for a structural design calculation. For a 25 mm board fixed to a timber support, a 60 to 75 mm nail may be considered, depending on joint movement, timber density and edge distance. For a 38 mm board, a 75 to 90 mm nail is often evaluated. With two 50 mm members, a 100 to 125 mm nail may be suitable, but the point should not project into a visible or hazardous area. Reduce the nominal length when the timber is very thin, when the nail is driven near an edge, or when the material can split. Pre-drilling or a blunt point may be appropriate for dense hardwood, but this must be agreed with the installer. For framing, pallet and crate work, calculate the total thickness, subtract any gap or soft facing layer, and confirm the remaining penetration. Also check nail spacing, grain direction and moisture movement. A 4 inch nail is not automatically correct for every 4 inch timber; the joint geometry controls the selection.
body.zh: 选择钉长时，应计算材料叠加厚度、所需穿透深度以及钉尖穿出的风险。普通木材可采用一个实用起点：钉子进入承托木材的深度，通常至少为被固定较薄木件厚度的2至2.5倍，同时还要保证支撑件中有足够的有效埋入长度。这只是典型的施工参考，不能替代结构设计计算。比如用25毫米木板固定到木方上，可根据接缝移动、木材密度和边距评估60至75毫米钉子。对于38毫米木板，常可评估75至90毫米钉子。两块50毫米木材连接时，100至125毫米钉子可能合适，但钉尖不应穿入可见或有安全风险的区域。木材很薄、靠近边缘打钉或材料容易开裂时，应缩短名义长度。对于密度较高的硬木，可以考虑预钻孔或使用较钝的钉尖，但必须与施工人员确认。框架、托盘和木箱作业应先计算总厚度，扣除间隙或软质面层，再确认剩余穿透深度。同时检查钉距、木纹方向和含水变化。4英寸木材并不自动意味着使用4英寸钉子，最终选择由接缝几何条件决定。

heading.zh: 亮面、电镀锌与热浸镀锌表面处理

body.en: Bright common nails have no intentional zinc coating, so they are usually the lowest-cost option for dry indoor timber, pallets, crates and short-term work. They can rust quickly when exposed to rain, condensation, wet timber, salt or chemically treated wood. Electro-galvanized nails receive a comparatively thin zinc coating through an electrical plating process. They provide better initial corrosion resistance than bright nails and usually have a cleaner, more uniform appearance, but the coating can be damaged during driving and may not suit long outdoor exposure. Hot-dip galvanized, or HDG, nails are coated by immersing the steel in molten zinc. The coating is generally thicker and more robust, although surface texture, zinc buildup and head appearance can vary. HDG is normally considered when nails will face outdoor humidity, wet construction, coastal air, treated timber or repeated condensation. Ask the supplier to state the coating type, coating target, base steel, finish tolerance and whether the coating is applied before or after forming. Do not treat every silver-colored nail as galvanized. For projects moving through Beira or Durban, finish choice should reflect the destination climate, storage conditions and time at port, not just the purchase price. A target coating standard may be specified in the purchase order, but the buyer should agree the measurement method and acceptance limit before production.
body.zh: 亮面普通圆钉没有专门的锌层，通常成本最低，适合干燥室内木材、托盘、木箱和短期作业。遇到雨水、冷凝水、湿木材、盐分或经过化学处理的木材时，可能较快生锈。电镀锌钉通过电镀工艺形成相对较薄的锌层，比亮面钉具有更好的初始耐腐蚀性，外观通常也更整齐，但打钉时涂层可能受损，不一定适合长期户外暴露。热浸镀锌，也就是HDG，是把钢材浸入熔融锌中形成涂层。该涂层通常更厚、更耐用，但表面纹理、锌层堆积和钉头外观可能存在差异。户外潮湿、湿法施工、沿海空气、经过处理的木材或反复冷凝环境，通常应评估HDG。采购时要求供应商注明镀层类型、镀层目标值、基材钢种、表面公差，以及镀层是在成形前还是成形后施加。不能把所有银色钉子都视为镀锌钉。经贝拉或德班运输的项目，应结合目的地气候、仓储条件和港口停留时间选择表面处理，而不能只看采购价格。订单中可以指定目标镀层标准，但应在生产前约定测量方法和验收限值。

heading.en: Packing: 25 kg Cartons and Pallet Loads
heading.zh: 包装：25公斤纸箱与托盘装载

body.en: A 25 kg carton is a common commercial packing format for loose common nails because it balances carrying weight, counting efficiency and container handling. The carton should identify nail size, finish, net weight, gross weight, lot or batch reference and country of origin where required by the buyer. Confirm whether the quoted 25 kg is net nail weight or gross carton weight; this difference affects landed cost and quantity planning. For mixed-size orders, use separate cartons for each size unless the buyer has approved a mixed carton, because mixed packing increases receiving and inventory errors. Carton board should resist compression, and the inner bag or liner should limit zinc dust, moisture and nail leakage. Pallet loads should be agreed by carton count, pallet dimensions, maximum height and maximum gross weight rather than by an assumed universal standard. A typical shipment plan may use uniform cartons stacked in interlocking layers, with corner protection and stretch film, but the exact load depends on container height, forklift access and destination handling. Ask for a packing list showing cartons per pallet, pallet net weight, pallet gross weight and total cubic volume. Before dispatch, verify carton marks against the purchase order and photograph pallet condition. For routes to Beira or Durban, protect cartons from rain during transfer and avoid storing them directly on wet ground after arrival. Packaging prevents handling loss; it does not replace corrosion protection.
body.zh: 25公斤纸箱是散装普通圆钉常见的商业包装规格，因为它兼顾了搬运重量、计数效率和集装箱操作。纸箱上应标明钉子尺寸、表面处理、净重、毛重、批次或生产批号，以及买方要求的原产国信息。必须确认报价中的25公斤是钉子净重还是纸箱毛重，因为两者会影响到岸成本和数量计划。混合尺寸订单最好按不同规格分箱，除非买方已批准混装，因为混装会增加收货和库存错误。纸箱纸板应有足够抗压能力，内袋或内衬应减少锌粉、潮气和钉子散漏。托盘装载应以纸箱数量、托盘尺寸、最大高度和最大毛重为依据，不能默认所有项目都采用同一标准。典型装载可以使用统一纸箱交错堆叠，并加护角和缠绕膜，但具体方案取决于集装箱高度、叉车通道和目的地装卸条件。要求装箱单列明每托纸箱数、托盘净重、托盘毛重和总体积。出货前，将纸箱唛头与采购订单逐项核对，并拍摄托盘状态。运往贝拉或德班的货物，应在转运中防雨，抵达后也不要直接放在潮湿地面上。包装可以减少搬运损失，但不能替代表面防腐处理。

heading.en: Quality Checks: Wire Gauge, Head Hold and Bend Test
heading.zh: 质量检查：线规、钉头保持力与弯曲试验

body.en: A practical inspection plan should verify dimensions, appearance, material consistency and functional performance before shipment. Wire gauge is an indirect way to describe shank diameter, so the purchase order should state the actual diameter in millimetres and the accepted tolerance. Measure several pieces from different cartons with a calibrated micrometer, avoiding the point, head fillet and any damaged area. Head hold testing checks whether the flat head remains attached to the shank under an agreed pulling or driving load. The exact load should be defined by the target standard or buyer specification; do not invent a pass value after production. A bend test checks whether the nail can bend through an agreed angle without sudden head separation, severe cracking or unacceptable coating loss. The test fixture, sample count, bend angle, speed and acceptance criteria should be written before inspection. Also check nail length from the underside of the head to the point, head diameter, point centering, shank straightness, burrs and visible rust. Sampling can follow a recognized acceptance-sampling method, but the buyer and supplier must agree the inspection level and critical defects. For a mixed container, inspect every size and finish rather than applying results from one carton to all cartons. Keep signed inspection records, sample labels and photographs linked to the lot number. These checks support consistent receiving decisions, but they are not a substitute for engineering approval of a load-bearing connection.
body.zh: 实用的验货计划应在出货前检查尺寸、外观、材料一致性和使用性能。线规只是描述钉杆直径的一种间接方式，因此订单中应同时写明毫米直径及允许公差。应从不同纸箱抽取样品，用校准合格的千分尺测量，避开钉尖、钉头过渡圆角和明显损伤部位。钉头保持力试验用于检查平头在约定拉力或打击载荷下是否仍牢固连接在钉杆上。具体载荷应由目标标准或买方规格确定，不能在生产完成后临时编造合格数值。弯曲试验用于检查钉子按约定角度弯曲时，是否出现钉头突然脱落、严重裂纹或不可接受的镀层剥落。试验夹具、样品数量、弯曲角度、速度和验收标准应在验货前书面确定。还应检查从钉头下方到钉尖的长度、钉头直径、钉尖居中度、钉杆直线度、毛刺和可见锈蚀。抽样可以参考认可的验收抽样方法，但买卖双方必须事先约定检验水平和关键缺陷定义。混装集装箱应检查每一种尺寸和表面处理，不能把一个纸箱的结果套用于全部纸箱。签字后的检验记录、样品标签和照片应与批次号对应。这些检查有助于稳定收货判断，但不能替代承重连接的工程批准。

heading.en: Sourcing from China to Beira and Durban
heading.zh: 从中国采购并运往贝拉与德班

body.en: For buyers in Zimbabwe, Zambia, South Africa and Mozambique, a common-nail order should be planned around product specification and the delivery route together. Start with one written specification covering size, diameter, finish, point, carton weight, pallet rules, inspection method and required documents. Request a quotation that separates product cost, packing, inland transport, ocean freight, insurance if required, port charges and destination delivery. Beira can be relevant for Mozambique and inland corridors toward Zimbabwe and parts of Zambia, while Durban is often considered for South African distribution and some regional cargo flows. The best route depends on the final consignee, border process, transit plan, container availability and total landed cost; no port is automatically faster or cheaper for every order. Confirm whether the shipment is full-container or consolidated cargo, and check how 25 kg cartons will be handled during transshipment. For bright nails, control humidity during storage and inland transport. For galvanized nails, keep cartons dry and prevent standing water from contacting the metal. Ask TradeGo for a pre-production specification sheet, carton marking draft, packing list format and inspection plan, then approve a reference sample before mass production when the application is sensitive. Do not assume a quotation includes customs clearance, local taxes, terminal handling or final-mile delivery. A clear Incoterm, consignee address and document list reduce avoidable delays without making unsupported promises about stock, production capacity or transit time.
body.zh: 对于津巴布韦、赞比亚、南非和莫桑比克的买方，普通圆钉订单应同时围绕产品规格和交付路线进行规划。首先制定一份书面规格，包含尺寸、直径、表面处理、钉尖、纸箱重量、托盘要求、验货方法和所需文件。询价时要求分别列出产品价格、包装、内陆运输、海运费、必要时的保险费、港口费用和目的地配送费用。贝拉可用于莫桑比克以及通往津巴布韦和部分赞比亚地区的内陆通道；德班通常会被考虑用于南非分销及部分区域货物流转。最佳路线取决于最终收货人、边境流程、中转安排、集装箱供应和总到岸成本，不能认为某个港口对所有订单都更快或更便宜。确认货物是整柜还是拼箱，并了解中转过程中25公斤纸箱的搬运方式。亮面钉应在仓储和内陆运输中控制湿度；镀锌钉也应保持纸箱干燥，避免金属长期接触积水。可要求TradeGo提供生产前规格表、纸箱唛头草案、装箱单格式和验货计划；对于用途敏感的项目，批量生产前应先批准参考样品。不能默认报价已经包含清关、当地税费、码头操作费或最后一公里配送费。明确贸易术语、收货地址和文件清单，可以减少可避免的延误，但不应对库存、产能或运输时间作无依据承诺。
